source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseApprovalRecycleEdgeTest { @isTest static void emptyRecycleBinRemovesDeletedRow() { Account a = new Account(Name = 'Acme'); insert a; delete a; Database.EmptyRecycleBinResult result = Database.emptyRecycleBin(a, false); System.assert(result.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(a.Id, result.getId()); System.assertEquals(0, result.getErrors().size()); List<Account> rows = [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id = :a.Id ALL ROWS]; System.assertEquals(0, rows.size()); } @isTest static void lockAndUnlockExposeResults() { Account a = new Account(Name = 'Acme'); insert a; Account b = new Account(Name = 'Beta'); insert b; Database.LockResult dbLocked = Database.lock(a, false); System.assert(dbLocked.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(a.Id, dbLocked.getId()); System.assertEquals(0, dbLocked.getErrors().size()); Database.UnlockResult dbUnlocked = Database.unlock(a, false); System.assert(dbUnlocked.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(a.Id, dbUnlocked.getId()); System.assertEquals(0, dbUnlocked.getErrors().size()); System.assert(!Approval.isLocked(a)); Approval.LockResult lockObject = Approval.lock(a); System.assert(lockObject.isSuccess()); System.assert(Approval.isLocked(a.Id)); Approval.UnlockResult unlockObject = Approval.unlock(a); System.assert(unlockObject.isSuccess()); Approval.LockResult lockObjectAllOrNone = Approval.lock(a, false); System.assert(lockObjectAllOrNone.isSuccess()); Approval.UnlockResult unlockIdAllOrNone = Approval.unlock(a.Id, false); System.assert(unlockIdAllOrNone.isSuccess()); Approval.LockResult lockId = Approval.lock(a.Id); System.assert(lockId.isSuccess()); Approval.UnlockResult unlockId = Approval.unlock(a.Id); System.assert(unlockId.isSuccess()); List<Id> ids = new List<Id>{a.Id, b.Id}; List<Approval.LockResult> lockIds = Approval.lock(ids); System.assertEquals(2, lockIds.size()); Map<Id, Boolean> idStates = Approval.isLocked(ids); System.assertEquals(true, idStates.get(a.Id)); List<Approval.UnlockResult> unlockIds = Approval.unlock(ids); System.assertEquals(2, unlockIds.size()); List<Approval.LockResult> lockIdsAllOrNone = Approval.lock(ids, false); System.assertEquals(2, lockIdsAllOrNone.size()); List<Approval.UnlockResult> unlockIdsAllOrNone = Approval.unlock(ids, false); System.assertEquals(2, unlockIdsAllOrNone.size()); List<SObject> records = new List<SObject>(); records.add(a); records.add(b); List<Approval.LockResult> lockObjects = Approval.lock(records); System.assertEquals(2, lockObjects.size()); Map<Id, Boolean> recordStates = Approval.isLocked(records); System.assertEquals(true, recordStates.get(a.Id)); List<Approval.UnlockResult> unlockObjects = Approval.unlock(records); System.assertEquals(2, unlockObjects.size()); List<Approval.LockResult> lockObjectsAllOrNone = Approval.lock(records, false); System.assertEquals(2, lockObjectsAllOrNone.size()); List<Approval.UnlockResult> unlockObjectsAllOrNone = Approval.unlock(records, false); System.assertEquals(2, unlockObjectsAllOrNone.size()); System.assert(!Approval.isLocked(a)); } }
